en.headline: HKMA holds base rate at 4.25 per cent after Fed decision
en.dek: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority kept its base rate unchanged on Thursday, matching the US Federal Reserve’s hold of its target range at 3.75 to 4 per cent.
body: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority said on Thursday it would keep the base rate at 4.25 per cent.

The decision followed the US Federal Reserve’s choice on Wednesday to hold its benchmark rate steady in a range of 3.75 to 4 per cent. Hong Kong’s currency is pegged to the US dollar, so the city’s monetary authority typically tracks the Fed’s moves.
In September the HKMA had followed the Fed in raising the base rate by a quarter of a percentage point, the first increase since 2023. Banks set their own prime rates separately from the base rate.

zh.headline: 金管局維持基本利率4.25厘 跟隨聯儲局按兵不動
zh.dek: 香港金融管理局周四宣布維持基本利率於4.25厘不變，與美國聯儲局維持目標區間3.75至4厘的決定一致。
body: 香港金融管理局周四表示，將基本利率維持在4.25厘。
有關決定緊隨美國聯儲局周三將基準利率維持在3.75至4厘區間。由於港元與美元掛鉤，金管局通常跟隨聯儲局的利率步伐。
今年九月，金管局曾跟隨聯儲局將基本利率上調四分之一個百分點，為2023年以來首次加息。銀行則自行釐定最優惠利率，與基本利率分開。
